crossing_policy: first ocean-to-land crossing in the inclusive requested window
merge_rule: keep no-storm separate; merge smallest pair sharing outcome, then lexicographic keys; if needed merge storm outcomes; cap also at K
allocation_rule: one per nonempty stratum, then capacity-bounded largest remainder proportional to population count, lexical ties
sampling_rule: SHA256(seed,stratum,member_id) ascending; uniform without replacement under a uniformly random seed
